item.tib: dbal phur 'bar ba nag po'i 'phrin las me ri 'khyil pa rin chen gter mdzod kyi rgyud las g.yung drung tshe yi sgrub pa zla dkar shel gyi 'khor lo
item.coloph: ces pa 'di ni mkha' 'gro 'od ldan 'bar mas shing yos lor hor zla gsum pa'i tshes bco'i lnga'i nyi shar skabs su mngon du mdun gyi dam mkhar byon nas gsang gsum lung gi d+ha (brda') rnams snyan du brgyud cing sems su zhugs nas/ slar sa rta zla 1tshes bzang por sa gnad spa yi sga'i dmar du mi 'gyur tshe dbang gsang sngags grags pas phab nas/ yi ge pa ni tshul bla rdor dza'i (dzas) bgyis la g.yung drung bon gyi bstan pa rin po che 'di nub med kun tu rgyas nas/ ma gyur mkha' mnyam 'gro rnams rdzogs sku mkha' 'gying sku ru gyur cig pa'i smon pa dang bcas te dge legs 'phel rgyas shog/
